description:
Calculate PERT expected duration from three-point estimates using Beta distribution.

Formula: E = (O + 4M + P) / 6. Returns expected value, variance, standard deviation,
and 95%/99% confidence bounds with urgency categorization.
Use when estimating task duration with uncertain outcomes.

ai_native.description: Degree of AI assistance: 0.0 = fully human, 1.0 = fully AI-native, 0.5 = hybrid. Accepts boolean for backward compatibility (true=1.0, false=0.0).

complexity.description: Optional complexity hint from 1 (trivial) to 5 (extreme). Reserved for future per-complexity correction-factor conditioning; not yet applied to the headline estimate.

most_likely.description: Mode of the distribution — the single most probable outcome.

optimistic.description: Best-case duration. Do NOT use your initial optimistic guess — this should be the absolute minimum if everything goes perfectly.

pessimistic.description: Worst-case duration accounting for known risks and unknown unknowns.

project.description: Optional project/repo identifier this estimate belongs to, for cross-project analytics.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier (minted by a calling agent/hook) used to deduplicate repeated estimate calls for the same task within a session.

task_label.description: Optional free-text label identifying the task this estimate is for (e.g. an issue key or short title). Surfaced on get_pending_estimates output for triage.

task_type.description: Optional task type for feedback matching. Enables per-task-type accuracy tracking.

unit.description: Time unit for all three PERT estimates.

name: pert_estimate
